plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Social Work, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/social-work-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Social Work Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 4 = 'See approved General Education list for the AA/AS Degree', 5 = 'See program recommendations or requirements', 7 = 'Students interested in pursuing UNR's BA/BSW Sociology and Social Work should meet with an Academic Advisor' — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. Designed to substantially meet the first two years of the BSW at UNR, with a possible start on a minor in addiction treatment services. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
